The '''''Spined Rancor Poster''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> It depicted the theoretical process for incubating a spined [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]].<ref name="TCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Spined Rancor Poster'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The ''Spined Rancor Poster'' loot card was only obtainable from the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]] "Nightsister Roundup" scenario which lasted through Tuesday, [[March 16]], [[2010]] at 2 p.m. PST.<ref name="TCG" />
